notes.notes:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

We have the next update ready! Thanks to you!
Your commitment is amazing ːsteamhappyː 

But before we explain what's actually in this update, here's a brief instruction.

Sometimes you can have a problem with launching the game (or some parts of it) after the update. This issue could be related to Steam and not the game itself. If you encounter a problem like that, please check your local files here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/6a0b6134c57b108349488e9ecf7931b02558ee19.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/be2f292d4c21d7e933701e1b42af54998a784cbc.png[/img]

[h3]And now, let's get back to our update...[/h3]

[h3][b]1. We added the possibility to add your custom paintings in the Sandbox mode![/b]
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/59da1b59253a44eabd0d1c6ed3e6efbaceaec222.png[/img]

[b]HOW TO ADD YOUR PICTURES?[/b]
You need to find the folder on your PC:

C:\Users\YOURNAME\AppData\LocalLow\DreamWay Games\Espresso Tycoon\GameState\CustomImages

YOURNAME - it's a placeholder here, there should be your name on your PC ːsteamhappyː

There are 3 files:
[list]
[*] painting-1x1.png
[*] painting-9x16.png
[*] painting-16x9.png
[/list]
You need to add pictures there with EXACTLY the same name.

And you can choose different picture frames (and different colors, too).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/063c78a9b7270d5e168db1b470272e31344573a1.png[/img]
These are some drawings made by children from our DreamWay Games family ːsteamhappyː

[h3][b]2. We added the possibility to add your custom logo in the Brand Editor![/b]
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/4a314568189f105ed409c2ea3ca043fefdfcefbf.png[/img]

[b]HOW TO ADD YOUR LOGO?[/b]
You need to go to the same folder that was mentioned before:

C:\Users\YOURNAME\AppData\LocalLow\DreamWay Games\Espresso Tycoon\GameState\CustomImages

There are 3 files:
[list]
[*] brand-1.png
[*] brand-2.png
[*] brand-3.png
[/list]
You need to add pictures there with EXACTLY the same name. They will look best when they are white (because the colors will not look the same as in your picture - quite like the pictures in our Latte Arts).

Who wouldn't want to relax in a five-star hotel with a good cup of coffee? Take care of your customers who want to enjoy a relaxing stay here. They also want to enjoy some pieces of art! Do you think you'll be able to bring the 'Mona Lisa' here?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c34fde6ebaede884f22089388985a4e8e05df6ed.png[/img]
[b]
8. Sydney[/b]
That location is pretty popular. You've chosen the underwater coffee shop as our Prologue's location. Run a successful coffee business and take care of the sea creatures (and customers, too, of course)!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/311894edb8ac63608fc2ea783eb4029741ebfa15.jpg[/img]

[b]9. Los Angeles[/b]
To get to Hollywood - this is the dream of many. And you will be able to run your cafe there! Beach, palm trees, ocean, and good coffee - it's a match!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/1d7512b429685754a04f589353767d90cb2a186c.png[/img]

[b]10. Tokyo[/b]
Last but not least! Tokyo is still the world's largest city in terms of population, so you can expect to need a lot of coffee there... Will you manage to take care of so many customers?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/6b357b290449dde956af8dbd3c341e8e57ef609c.png[/img]

Of course, this is just a brief description. We will be presenting each of them in detail soon!
Which one is your favorite?

notes.title: PROLOGUE'S RELEASE DATE REVEAL- 4th of November!

[previewyoutube=p-mKPJ_hNHQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/c3f4959d57a615506d5e27178e9ec2802706b16f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/6761e06621f575ac1616d4f711d5df1ca7f2a905.png[/img]

- toppings in the coffee editor

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/871d655e5ce80f9270d118e945e3ce1ca767b74d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/dd6549ae745874e36583c5676c136e8227fadb67.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/d472637c79853fa42a03590219e6da2036f554d2.png[/img]

Your Coffee Enthusiasts,
